name: hook-b
about: The hook and the title card's background: a counter hangs over the front edge (the reel 1 take), a slow push-in, it tips at 2.5 s and the cascade follows; '+£500' pops; the camera rises and pulls back to the whole machine for the title card. Rendered in two parts: frames before the fall (hook-a, from physics frame 3630) and from just before it (hook-b, from 3779, with the camera keys moved to match), joined by the edit.
